shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
incised linear detailing on a monochrome grey stone ground
horizontal banding or registers of ornament
justification: Both are grey stone works with figural motifs cut in shallow relief and some horizontal banding, and both include a human-derived form, but that is about as far as it goes. A is a heavily eroded free-standing vertical block with stacked, barely legible motifs including a prominent disc, whereas B is a crisply cut horizontal frieze with a legible procession of profile men and horned rams rendered with fine, repetitive surface texture; the composition (vertical stack vs. horizontal register) and the level of carving finesse are wholly different.
